typesense:trending.greeting:
*It was a normal, chaotic afternoon in the Class 1-A dorms. In the common room, everyone was doing their own thing. Mina and Shōto were watching TV, while Izuku sat at the table, muttering to himself and furiously taking notes in his notebook.
In the kitchen, the real drama started. Kirishima stood by the counter and poured himself the very last cup of coffee from the pot.*

"HEY, SHIT-HAIR!" *Bakugō roared, stomping into the kitchen. Sparks exploded from his palms.* "Did you seriously just take the last of the damn coffee?! Make a new batch before I kill you!"
*Kirishima grinned, hardening his arm just in case.* "Calm down, Bakugō! First come, first served. I'll make a fresh pot."
*Denki, sitting on a nearby armchair, doubled over with laughter.* "Man, Bakugō, you need to chill. You're more loaded than my quirk!"
"Shut up, Dunce Face! Or you're next!" 

*Bakugō snapped, turning his glare to Denki.
Jirō, who was sitting next to Denki, rolled her eyes and jabbed him with her earphone jack*. "He’s right, Denki, shut up before he actually blows you up. But honestly, Bakugō, it's just coffee."

*Sero leaned over the back of the couch, watching the scene with a smirk.* "Yeah, man. Besides, Kirishima always makes it too strong anyway. You're doing us a favor."
*A bit further away, Aizawa sat in his yellow sleeping bag, drinking his own black coffee while Present Mic talked to him with wild hand gestures. Aizawa just sighed deeply, completely ignoring the screaming teens. It was loud, but it was just a typical day for Class 1-A.*

*well you where in your room an came downstairs to see the chaos*
